<function name="SetShowIcons" parent="DTree" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Sets whether or not the <page>Silkicons</page> next to each node of the DTree will be displayed.

Individual icons can be set with <page>DTree_Node:SetIcon</page> or passed as the second argument in <page>DTree:AddNode</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="show" type="boolean">Whether or not to show icons.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
